Hello, Fernanda. You asked me about my English. Well, I have worked in this company for eleven years, and I have worked with people from about twenty countries. I have never spoken perfect English. I know I have an accent, and I know I speak fast when I am tired. But I have learned one important thing: people do not need perfect English. They need to understand each other. When you asked me to repeat, or to write something in the chat, it helped me too. So thank you. Your English has improved a lot this year.

You know, Fernanda, I have tried to learn Portuguese. Two times, actually. I have used apps, and I have watched Brazilian series with subtitles. But I have never given a presentation in Portuguese. I can say only three sentences: good morning, thank you, and see you later. So when you present to us in English, I think about that. You are working in your second language, and you are doing it well. I respect that a lot.
